metadata.title: Cambridge IELTS Academic Practice - Test 1
metadata.sectionType: Social Needs (Dialogue: Student Housing & Accommodation Enquiry)
metadata.transcript:
Advisor: Good morning, Student Accommodation Services. How can I help you today?
Student: Hello, I am looking for a shared apartment near the university campus for the upcoming semester.
metadata.questionsSummary: Questions 1-10: Complete the student booking form with room type, rent budget, and contract duration.
metadata.source: Cambridge IELTS Practice Master Bank

metadata.title: Cambridge IELTS Academic Practice - Test 2
metadata.sectionType: General Interest (Monologue: Historical Botanical Gardens Orientation)
metadata.transcript: Guide: Welcome everyone to the Royal Botanical Gardens. Before we begin our guided tour, please take a look at the visitor map...
metadata.questionsSummary: Questions 11-20: Label the visitor map and match garden zones with their designated plant collections.
metadata.source: Cambridge IELTS Practice Master Bank

metadata.title: Cambridge IELTS Academic Practice - Test 3
metadata.sectionType: Academic Discussion (Dialogue: Research Methodology & Statistical Analysis)
metadata.transcript: Tutor: So Elena and Mark, let us review your preliminary dissertation findings regarding cognitive spaced retrieval in language acquisition.
metadata.questionsSummary: Questions 21-30: Multiple choice regarding control group sample size, qualitative variables, and experimental validity.
metadata.source: Cambridge IELTS Practice Master Bank

metadata.title: Cambridge IELTS Academic Practice - Test 4
metadata.sectionType: Academic Monologue (University Lecture: Deep-Sea Ecosystems & Ocean Acidification)
metadata.transcript: Professor: Today we will explore the biogeochemical consequences of rising carbon absorption on abyssal benthic communities...
metadata.questionsSummary: Questions 31-40: Note completion regarding hydrothermal vents, trophic cascades, and biodiversity indices.
metadata.source: Cambridge IELTS Practice Master Bank
